sources.label: Corpus Denetim independent TRYB assurance report - August 17, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Corpus Denetim's independent auditor examination, signed August 17, 2026, covers the Reserve Account Information of BiLira Kripto Varlık Alım Satım Platformu as of August 17, 2026 at 12:00 GMT+3. It reports 61,600,302 TRYB tokens issued and outstanding and TL 66,400,788 held in custody accounts, concluding that the issued and outstanding tokens do not exceed the Turkish-lira balance. The auditor's opinion states that the reserve-account information is correctly stated in all material respects. The accompanying notes describe the complete reserve category as Turkish-lira balances in segregated accounts at federally insured Turkish-lira depository institutions, but the notes are outside the auditor's assurance and do not name the banks or provide their allocation. The curated composition therefore remains 100% TRY cash reserves.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Corpus Denetim independent auditor examination of BiLira's Reserve Account Report as of August 17, 2026
